title: LiteLLM Supply Chain Attack / Unauthorized Code Identified
summary: Unauthorized code identified in LiteLLM v1.82.7 and v1.82.8 on PyPI (March 24, 2026). Affects Agent Development Kit (ADK) Python users. Highlights the risk of coding agents pulling in compromised dependencies during automated tasks.

title: Claude Code Supply Chain Attack (March 31, 2026)
summary: A supply-chain attack on March 31, 2026 affected npm-based Claude Code installations. Users advised to verify dependency integrity and review lockfiles for unauthorized packages. Signals that coding agents are being targeted as a vector for supply-chain infiltration.

title: Optio - Orchestrate AI coding agents from ticket to PR
summary: Open-source orchestration system for Claude Code/Codex. Handles full lifecycle: ticket -> K8s execution -> PR monitoring -> Auto-merge. Highlights the trend toward fully autonomous agentic PR lifecycles where humans are removed as bottlenecks.

title: G0 – The control layer for AI agents
summary: A unified security and governance layer for agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf). Features static/behavioral analysis, adversarial red teaming, and MDM-level agent discovery. Directly addresses the need for 'authority' and 'governance' in agentic workflows.

title: APM - Agent Package Manager
summary: Microsoft-led OSS tool to manage agent dependencies (skills, prompts, MCP servers) with lockfiles and audits. Scans for hidden Unicode/supply-chain attacks. Acknowledges that 'agent configuration' is a new category of dependency requiring enterprise-grade management.

title: Sweet! CLI - Cheaper alternative with 'Autopilot'
summary: Features 'autopilot' mode for monitoring and triaging live production outages. Founder has 'multiple Sweet! agents deployed to the production server right now.' Signals increasing trust/reliance on agents for production-level interventions.
